rubric.rationale: Scope narrowed to descriptive internal comparison; limited clinical novelty remains.
Official hashes,283-variable header/layout, identity/split and interview dates resolved.
20 recodes/units verified; literature attribution corrected; timing/ascertainment unresolved.
Fold-isolated learned steps verified; sequential design and pre-split covariate screening remain.
Seven fixed learning configurations verified; untuned-family and overfitting limits remain.
Bootstrap/McNemar reproduced; clipping/multiplicity/conditional uncertainty explicit; no independent validation.
AP, naive baseline and calibration verified; corrected figures; no clinical thresholds.
16 identities verified and load-bearing claims corrected; some full texts/supplements remain unverified.
Source/hash/environment/reconstruction/gates improved; no serialized fitted pipelines or durable artifact guarantee.
52-subitem audit and characteristics/dates added; author declarations/journal manuscript remain.
Unsupported inference removed; numerical and scientific validity separated.
